name: ilang-wechat-awesome
description: WeChat official account writing assistant with data-driven topic hunting (wxrank, user's own key). Feeds on your source material, restructures it with writing genes distilled from 200+ field-tested articles, runs a 12-point self-check with built-in de-AI editing, outputs publish-ready Markdown plus titles and a cover image prompt, and can push the approved draft into the WeChat draft box through the official API (draft box by default; a verified enterprise account can publish only after a human reviewed the draft and said so). Chinese-first. By iLang.

displayDescription.en: Hunt topics with real read and share data first, then feed it your source material and it restructures the piece with writing genes distilled from 200+ field-tested WeChat articles, runs a 12-point self-check with built-in de-AI editing, then outputs publish-ready Markdown, three titles and a cover image prompt while following WeChat content rules. One sentence pushes the approved draft into your WeChat draft box (never publishes). By iLang.
